title: Execution-time frozen priority-variant BBJ validation plan
scope: 10 existing T07 priority representatives x 2 traits; variant-level association support only
target_filter: five_class_primary != unresolved; original priority file contains 11 records including GSU058 unresolved; freeze the 10 classified primary units only
excluded_discovery_candidate: GSU058 unresolved; excluded by discovery classification before external target extraction, not by external results
multiple_testing: Separate Bonferroni families of 20 for association, heterogeneity and equivalence; missing variants stay in denominator; no combined three-family FWER claim
association_rule: Original two-sided source P <= 0.0025 and direction relative to same-trait FinnGen ALT effect; opposite significant associations listed separately
equivalence_rule: TOST normal approximation; max(one-sided P) <= 0.0025, equivalent to 99.5% CI within [-log(1.10),log(1.10)]; independent flag even if association is significant
precision_rule: Two-sided normal-approximation precision scenario at fixed abs(logOR)=log(1.10) using supplied BBJ SE; not source-SPA power, not observed power computed from BBJ beta
heterogeneity_rule: Q=(beta_BBJ-beta_FG)^2/(SE_BBJ^2+SE_FG^2), chi-square df1; I2=max(0,(Q-1)/Q), I2=0 when Q=0, reported as proportion; assumes distinct FG/BBJ cohorts
effect_scale: log odds ratio; exp(beta) is OR; BBJ Hashimoto mapped to FinnGen strict AIHT and BBJ Graves mapped to strict Graves, not asserted identical definitions
prior_exposure: T07 discovery results and prior T16/T17 preparation/QC/coverage were available; T17 aligned genome-wide file existed before this execution-time freeze. No claim of blind prospective preregistration; parameters not selected from external target association results.
